purpose: Shared immutable Model and isolated full-state Sessions; fixed teacher-forced CUDA consumer correctness.

implementation.shared: One 320-tensor weight bank, immutable finite family and selected child per shape.
implementation.isolated: Per-session 24-layer dense KV, conv/GDN ping-pong state, position/parity, IO, workspace and invocation slots.
implementation.execution: One original queue; complete evaluate calls alternate round-robin, no concurrent submits.
implementation.lifetime: Sessions declared after Model, drain and release slots before state and before Model destruction.

initial_two_and_four_sessions.policy: Teacher-forced inputs from existing fixed IDs. Compare exact same per-session journey against the retained single-session consumer. Round-robin is one full evaluate call at a time on one original queue; no simultaneous execution or service throughput claim.
initial_two_and_four_sessions.checker_correction: Decision vectors exclude routes/*.tsv metadata. Reuse only terminal exit-0 runs with exact command and image identity; no GPU rerun for completed cases.

checker_correction.classification: Host checker originally counted route TSV metadata as numeric vectors. Corrected suffix filter plus exact expected decision-file set. Resume accepts only exact command/image identity, completed exit0/no-timeout results. Existing alice/bob/interleaved2 process results were reused; carol/dave/interleaved4 then completed. No model/source/math/tolerance change or repeated execution of the completed first three processes is needed by this correction.

ownership_source_anchors.fact: Session owns all24layer mutable state plus per-shape Invocation/IO maps and drains each slot before resources die
Each create_session allocates separate six dense KVpairs and18dual-generation conv/GDNstates; replay count starts at this session parity0; no weight load or compile
Each invocation binds only its session state and own PhaseIO, while shared Family child handles remain model owned
One sharedModel/family union before per-session creation; serial dispatch calls evaluate on the selected Session without resetting other sessions

independent_review.conclusion: The frozen ownership split plus byte-identical full-model decision outputs under two/four distinct histories, different lengths, repeated decode shapes and second prefills supports functional isolation of the complete dense KV/conv/GDN session owners in this finite serial consumer. No cross-session interference was observed.
not_claimed: All internal KV/conv/GDN tensor bytes are equal: decisions-only traces contain final hidden/logits, not complete internal state dumps
Failure/cancellation isolation or resource-exhaustion admission was not exercised by these six successful processes

No concurrent device execution, service latency/throughput, memory-cost comparison or performance win: tracing marks all runs diagnostic and interleaved phase wall times include time spent servicing other sessions
No pooled pagedKV, prefix reuse/fork/COW, cache eviction, prefix quality equivalence or full-model quality qualification
One family compile per interleaved process is verified by logs/source; exact physical storage sharing/peakVRAM is not measured here

normal_final4.baseline: Same four original W standalone runs in attempt2; no additional baseline process

additional_final_source_validation.scope: The final865708e source/image is separately bound. The diagnostic namespace fix changes no arithmetic, final host-token endpoint or normal trace path; the optional layer0 dump already occurs after that endpoint. Probe traces additionally expose nine layer0 intermediates, not full24-layer state.

independent_review.vector_inventory_policy: All expected numeric files were independently read byte-for-byte and rehashed, with exact path/file-set checks. Complete per-vector SHA inventories remain in the three explicitly hashed original summary files; they are not duplicated here.

limitations: No shared-prefix/COW or automatic cache eviction delivered in this batch.
--max-sessions (default16) validates admission count, not a byte budget or preallocation of16 caches.
Configured limit1 has no new kernel route; an actual single-session input already uses one session.
All vector export runs are diagnostics; no new tokens/s, memory saving or service concurrency claim.
Endpoint vectors and ownership inspection do not prove all internal state bits, arbitrary journeys or failure/cancel paths.
Per-session wall includes other interleaved sessions; source clock bucket moved state allocation into shape preparation.
corrected_validation_issues: First deep trace path exceeded Windows path length; retained failing exit/logs, used short repo-local output.
Initial checker counted route TSVs as vectors; corrected exact decision-file set and reused only recorded exact-image/command exit-0 processes.
Multi-session layer0 probe output collision fixed using indexed session subdirectories; original single-session paths unchanged.
next: Bound cache sessions, active sequences and actual cache bytes; engine evicts idle entries, Hyle retains resources until native retirement.
Typed paged append with exact dirty-page writers and same-graph successor-read proof; shared prefix/COW and complete state snapshot publication.
reproduction: Bundle contains frozen consumer sources/headers, input IDs, scripts, identities, commands, raw logs and comparison hashes. Reuse existing matching dependencies/model resources; no weights, SDKs, executables or generated vector payloads copied into docs.
